services.name: 2 Hour Dolphin Tour
services.desc: 2 Hour Dolphin Tour Our 2 Hour Dolphin Tours is our most popular tour! Cruise with us along the Intracoastal Waterway along Casey Key, Siesta Key on our way to Downtown Sarasota and Sarasota Bay. We see Bird Key, Lido Key and Big Pass on this awesome adventure as we look for dolphin, manatee and other exciting wildlife. Our 2 hour tour is dolphin watching and sightseeing only, we don't anchor off at anytime during this tour. Our charters are exclusive and private to you and your guests.
